title: Venezuelans divided over future of country's leadership as Maduro regime remains in power
summary: For the people of Venezuela, the Maduro regime is still largely intact as Maduro's former vice president was sworn in Monday to lead the country. But there is still fear and uncertainty. Lilia Luciano spoke to a woman on the Colombian side of the border with Venezuela, who said she may return if a new leader is elected by the people.
